verses.original: רַּ֭ךְ מַֽעֲנֶה־ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה עֶ֝֗צֶב וּדְבַר־ יַעֲלֶה־ אָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: raḵ ma·‘ă·neh- yā·šîḇ ḥê·māh ‘e·ṣeḇ ū·ḏə·ḇar- ya·‘ă·leh- ’āp̄
verses.literal: A gentle answer turns away wrath but a harsh word stirs up anger

verses.original: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּפִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·wn ḥă·ḵā·mîm tê·ṭîḇ dā·‘aṯ ū·p̄î ḵə·sî·lîm yab·bî·a‘ ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge but the mouth of the fool spouts folly

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּֽכָל־ מָ֭קוֹם צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וטוֹבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê Yah·weh bə·ḵāl mā·qō·wm ṣō·p̄ō·wṯ rā·‘îm w·ṭō·ḇīm
verses.literal: The eyes of the LORD are in every place observing the evil and the good

verses.original: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְסֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּרֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: mar·pê lā·šō·wn ‘êṣ ḥay·yîm wə·se·lep̄ bāh še·ḇer bə·rū·aḥ
verses.literal: A soothing tongue is a tree of life but a perverse [tongue] crushes the spirit

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ אָבִ֑יו מוּסַ֣ר וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·wîl yin·’aṣ ’ā·ḇîw mū·sar wə·šō·mêr tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ ya‘·rim
verses.literal: A fool rejects his father’s discipline but whoever heeds correction is prudent

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק רָ֑ב חֹ֣סֶן וּבִתְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ ṣad·dîq rāḇ ḥō·sen ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·’aṯ rā·šā‘ ne‘·kā·reṯ
verses.literal: The house of the righteous has great treasure but the income of the wicked is trouble

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת לֹא־ כֵֽן׃ וְלֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: śip̄·ṯê ḥă·ḵā·mîm yə·zā·rū ḏā·‘aṯ lō- ḵên wə·lêḇ kə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: The lips of the wise spread knowledge but not so the hearts of fools

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּתְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ rə·šā·‘îm tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ū·ṯə·p̄il·laṯ yə·šā·rîm rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD but the prayer of the upright is His delight

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע יֶאֱהָֽב׃ וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ de·reḵ rā·šā‘ ye·’ĕ·hāḇ ū·mə·rad·dêp̄ ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: The LORD detests the way of the wicked but He loves those who pursue righteousness

verses.original: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְעֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: mū·sār rā‘ lə·‘ō·zêḇ ’ō·raḥ śō·w·nê ṯō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path he who hates correction will die

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl wa·’ă·ḇad·dō·wn ne·ḡeḏ Yah·weh ’ap̄ kî- lib·bō·wṯ bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD how much more . . . the hearts vvv of men

verses.original: לֵ֭ץ לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב־ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ לֹ֣א ל֑וֹ אֶל־ יֵלֵֽךְ׃ חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: lêṣ lō ye·’ĕ·haḇ- hō·w·ḵê·aḥ lō lōw ’el- yê·lêḵ ḥă·ḵā·mîm
verses.literal: A mocker does not love to be reproved nor will he vvv consult . . . the wise

verses.original: שָׂ֭מֵחַ לֵ֣ב יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּבְעַצְּבַת־ לֵ֝ב נְכֵאָֽה׃ ר֣וּחַ
verses.transliteration: śā·mē·aḥ lêḇ yê·ṭiḇ pā·nîm ū·ḇə·‘aṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ- lêḇ nə·ḵê·’āh rū·aḥ
verses.literal: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit

verses.original: נָ֭בוֹן לֵ֣ב יְבַקֶּשׁ־ דָּ֑עַת וּפְנֵי כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇō·wn lêḇ yə·ḇaq·qeš- dā·‘aṯ ū·p̄ə·nē ḵə·sî·lîm yir·‘eh ’iw·we·leṯ
verses.literal: A discerning heart seeks knowledge but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly

verses.original: כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְטֽוֹב־ לֵ֝֗ב תָמִֽיד׃ מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: kāl- yə·mê ‘ā·nî rā·‘îm wə·ṭō·wḇ- lêḇ ṯā·mîḏ miš·teh
verses.literal: All the days of the oppressed are bad but a cheerful heart has a continual feast

verses.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝֗ב מֵאוֹצָ֥ר וּמְה֥וּמָה בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- mə·‘aṭ bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh rāḇ mê·’ō·w·ṣār ū·mə·hū·māh ḇōw
verses.literal: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק שָׁ֑ם וְאַהֲבָה־ אָ֝ב֗וּס מִשּׁ֥וֹר וְשִׂנְאָה־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ’ă·ru·ḥaṯ yā·rāq šām wə·’a·hă·ḇāh- ’ā·ḇūs miš·šō·wr wə·śin·’āh- ḇōw
verses.literal: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred

verses.original: חֵ֭מָה אִ֣ישׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְאֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ḥê·māh ’îš yə·ḡā·reh mā·ḏō·wn wə·ʾɛ·rɛḵ ’ap·pa·yim yaš·qîṭ rîḇ
verses.literal: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife but he who is slow to anger calms dispute

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּמְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְאֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: de·reḵ ‘ā·ṣêl kim·śu·ḵaṯ ḥā·ḏeq wə·’ō·raḥ yə·šā·rîm sə·lu·lāh
verses.literal: The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns but the path of the upright is a highway

verses.original: חָ֭כָם בֵּ֣ן יְשַׂמַּח־ אָ֑ב וּכְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ḵām bên yə·śam·maḥ- ’āḇ ū·ḵə·sîl ’ā·ḏām bō·w·zeh ’im·mōw
verses.literal: A wise son brings joy to his father but a foolish man despises his mother

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַחֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב וְאִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לָֽכֶת׃ יְיַשֶׁר־
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ śim·ḥāh la·ḥă·sar- lêḇ wə·’îš tə·ḇū·nāh lå̄·ḵɛṯ yə·yaš·šer-
verses.literal: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment but a man of understanding walks a straight path

verses.original: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת הָפֵ֣ר בְּאֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּבְרֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ hā·p̄êr bə·’ên sō·wḏ ū·ḇə·rōḇ yō·w·‘ă·ṣîm tā·qūm
verses.literal: Plans fail for lack of counsel but with many advisers they succeed

verses.original: לָ֭אִישׁ שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְּמַעֲנֵה־ פִ֑יו מַה־ טּֽוֹב׃ בְּעִתּ֣וֹ וְדָבָ֖ר
verses.transliteration: lā·’îš śim·ḥāh bə·ma·‘ă·nêh- p̄îw mah- ṭō·wḇ bə·‘it·tōw wə·ḏā·ḇār
verses.literal: A man takes joy in a fitting reply . . . and how good is a timely word

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְמַ֣עְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מָֽטָּה׃ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל
verses.transliteration: ’ō·raḥ ḥay·yîm lə·ma‘·lāh lə·maś·kîl lə·ma·‘an sūr māṭ·ṭāh miš·šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: The path of life [leads] upward for the wise that he may avoid going down to Sheol

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה יִסַּ֥ח׀ בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים וְ֝יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yis·saḥ bêṯ gê·’îm wə·yaṣ·ṣêḇ gə·ḇūl ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD tears down the house of the proud but He protects the boundaries of the widow

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע אִמְרֵי־ וּ֝טְהֹרִ֗ים נֹֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ rā‘ ’im·rê- ū·ṭə·hō·rîm nō·‘am
verses.literal: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked but the words of the pure are pleasant [to Him]

verses.original: בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְשׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ ‘ō·ḵêr bê·ṯōw wə·śō·w·nê mat·tā·nōṯ yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household but he who hates bribes will live

verses.original: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַעֲנ֑וֹת וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ṣad·dîq yeh·geh la·‘ă·nō·wṯ ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm yab·bî·a‘ rā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֑ים יִשְׁמָֽע׃ וּתְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh rā·ḥō·wq mê·rə·šā·‘îm yiš·mā‘ ū·ṯə·p̄il·laṯ ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: The LORD is far from the wicked but He hears the prayer of the righteous

verses.original: מְֽאוֹר־ עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח־ לֵ֑ב ט֝וֹבָ֗ה שְׁמוּעָ֥ה תְּדַשֶּׁן־ עָֽצֶם׃
verses.transliteration: mə·’ō·wr- ‘ê·na·yim yə·śam·maḥ- lêḇ ṭō·w·ḇāh šə·mū·‘āh tə·ḏaš·šen- ‘ā·ṣem
verses.literal: The light of the eyes cheers the heart [and] good news nourishes the bones

verses.original: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת חַיִּ֑ים תּוֹכַ֣חַת תָּלִֽין׃ בְּקֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ō·zen šō·ma·ʿaṯ ḥay·yîm tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ tā·lîn bə·qe·reḇ ḥă·ḵā·mîm
verses.literal: vvv He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise

verses.original: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְשׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: pō·w·rê·a‘ mū·så̄r mō·w·’ês nap̄·šōw wə·šō·w·mê·a‘ tō·w·ḵa·ḥaṯ qō·w·neh lêḇ
verses.literal: He who ignores discipline despises himself but whoever heeds correction gains understanding

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה עֲנָוָֽה׃ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh mū·sar ḥāḵ·māh ‘ă·nā·wāh wə·lip̄·nê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD [is] the instruction of wisdom and humility comes before honor
